---
name: Content Authoring
applyTo: "docs/**,README.md,CHANGELOG.md,**/*.md"
description: Guidance for authoring content and documentation in this repository.
---

# Content authoring

- Keep documentation concise and task-oriented.
- Prefer factual, implementation-focused guidance over historical or speculative notes.
- Link to the canonical module or guide when a concept is already documented.
- Avoid duplicating long policy text in multiple files when one durable reference is enough.
